display_name: Merged World Tracker — World Milestones Fork
author: Brasen
description: Unified extension combining World State, Session Chronicle, Knowledge Tracker, Story Planner, Interiority (NPC thoughts & hidden intentions), and Ambient Conditions (deterministic weather) into a single modular system. Automatically tracks world state, chronicles sessions, manages NPC knowledge via lorebooks, brainstorms plot possibilities, generates out-of-band NPC interiority, and injects consistent ambient conditions. Opt-in World Milestones sequencing for episode-coded arcs (S1E01, S2E01, S3E01).
